paragraphs: He was a lender at interest, and Rava disqualified him from testimony. (See [Sanhedrin 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.25a.7).)[^1][^2]

notes.text: An isolated כ precedes the source citation.
The linked Gemara gives the two witnesses’ testimony about lending at interest and Rava’s disqualification of Bar Binitos.
